scientific_scope_status: The corrected internally reviewed controller-learning theorem supplies a finite-grid causal selector/importance-weighted learning route and an adaptive calibration minimax episode lower bound. Existing contextualKT and Peshkin-Mukherjee policy-search predecessors are credited.

unavailable_or_unclassified: The same conditional initial-law/plant kernels, supplied controller contexts and private-key exclusion are required. Last hidden state is not a fresh deployment start. Episode count is not total physical preparation, mixing, waiting or sensing cost. The fixed finite-gap family cannot be reused for every arbitrarily small accuracy; expected-stopping alternatives do not inherit a bound under every law. Broad universal-coding novelty was withdrawn. Finite executed diagnostics and the strong ordinary likelihood-ratio/DAC comparisons establish no device or advantage.
